TEXT.English: +20% unit production, -20% research, +100% distance and city-count maintenance.

TEXT.Spanish: +2 happiness in every city. Every ten turns, elections randomly change one other civic column.

TEXT.Spanish: +2 happiness in every city and +10% commerce.

TEXT.Spanish: Capture population as slaves; slave units can work in cities for 20 turns.
